notes_for_editor: Thin record: three short web listings and no dated source. The story is under the 120-word floor because the sources give no build date, builder, staffing, fires or site history, and the guide says to leave those out rather than describe the gaps. Elevations agree within rounding (469 m in OSM, 1,538 ft in TopoQuest). The Howell and Ozark County towersite plan at ia801203.us.archive.org may say whether the spot is now an MDC or county towersite; its fetch timed out twice and was not read. No NHLR or FFLOS entry for Sterling turned up in the local cache.
